title: Text: DET Ben Fidelman ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: “Tigers PR is really cracking down on the Fake News Media this year. You can’t stop walking behind pitchers throwing bullpen sessions, I’m told.”
It amazes me that they want you guys to do Facebook live and postgame videos, yet don’t buy you phones from this millennium
You’re talking about franklin Perez being on the far end of bullpen in today’s video and it’s a little fuzzball somewhere in the distance
